param_input_item.param_description: Timer object or timer object array.

description.p: delete stops timer objects and invalidates their handles. After deletion, isvalid returns false for those handles.
Delete timers when they are no longer needed. A deleted timer cannot be restarted.

example_item.example_item_description: Delete a timer after it has finished running.
Delete a running timer. The timer is stopped before the handle is invalidated.
